Proving Grounds — stage review

12 authored stages, 3×5 → 10×10. Terrain only — armies are generator output molded onto each stage (royal rearmost row, pawns in front; soft pawn-coverage violations flagged). For each stage: keep / tweak / kill — call tweaks by coordinates (walls are drawn in the JSON as ASCII, one char per square). Samples are seeded and reproducible; "not shown" means the generator rejected every attempt (that is data too). Balance testing runs every stage in BOTH vertical orientations (designer rule — mirrors are not separate scenarios), so judge terrain on its own merits, not by which side it faces.

Wave 2 — proposed (broken deployment ground)

Entirely new designs; every stage has walls inside the first/last two ranks, most in the very first or last rank — the molding stress set.

Gatehouse s13-gatehouse

6×8 · 6 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 7×2

Wave 2. Wall stubs inside BOTH back ranks: black loses its corners, white loses its left pair. Each army molds around its own gate before the fight starts.

Buried Flank s14-buried-flank

8×8 · 9 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Wave 2. Opposite flanks of the two back ranks are rubbled over (3 cells each, plus spill into the second rank). Armies deploy shifted toward opposite sides — built-in diagonal confrontation.

Colonnade s15-colonnade

7×9 · 7 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Wave 2. Pillar pairs INSIDE both pawn ranks (2 and 8) plus midfield columns. Pawn screens must form around the pillars — the pawn-row molding case.

Cave Mouth s16-cave-mouth

5×7 · 4 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 6×2

Wave 2. White back rank is walled except a 2-cell mouth (b1-c1): the whole army molds forward through it, royal wedged in the mouth. Black side open — maximum deployment asymmetry.

Rubble Start s17-rubble-start

9×8 · 6 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Wave 2. The inverse of wave 1: rubble concentrated in ranks 1-2 and 7-8, midfield CLEAR. All the terrain pain is at deployment, none in the fight.

Split Pockets s18-split-pockets

10×8 · 7 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Wave 2. Wall spurs divide both back ranks into two pockets. A wide army must mold into two clumps around its spur — the split-deployment case.

Diagonal Scar s19-diagonal-scar

8×9 · 8 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Wave 2. A broken diagonal streak from a1 to h9 touching both deployment zones. Neither side deploys clean; the scar leaves slip-gaps for king-steps and diagonal sliders.

The Anvil s20-the-anvil

4×9 · 5 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 6×2

Wave 2. Narrow board; white SECOND rank has a center wall pair (the pawn screen must split around it), black back corners clipped. Pawn-rank molding under compression.

Collapsed Keep s21-collapsed-keep

10×10 · 14 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Wave 2. The big broken-ground case at 10x10: rubble in both first AND second ranks plus midfield rooms. Everything molds, everywhere, at the size ceiling.

Sinkhole s22-sinkhole

6×7 · 6 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 7×2

Wave 2. A 2x2 central sink plus one wall in each back rank. The minimal broken-deployment stage — one obstruction per army, one hazard mid-board.

Wave 1 — locked

The clean-ground set, re-molded under v2.1 for reference.

The Closet s01-the-closet

3×5 · 0 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 3×2

Minimum board (3x5), open. Two armies one rank apart — the knife-fight lower bound. Tests: does a duel this cramped even read as chess?

Cracked Hall s02-cracked-hall

4×7 · 2 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 5×2

Narrow hall, sparse rubble offset left-then-right. Lightest possible terrain interference.

The Squeeze s03-the-squeeze

5×8 · 5 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 7×2

Off-center waist: the left side collapses to a 2-wide pass. Armies must fight through or around one choke. Asymmetric on purpose.

Pillared Court s04-pillared-court

6×8 · 2 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Two lone pillars, diagonal offset. Classic cover: cuts long files/diagonals without shaping rooms.

Collapsed Gallery s05-collapsed-gallery

7×9 · 6 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Rubble clump on the left flank mid-board; right flank fully open. Flank-choice terrain.

The Doorway s06-the-doorway

6×9 · 4 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

A wall line with one 2-wide door, off-center. The purest chokepoint: all traffic funnels through files d-e.

Twin Chambers s07-twin-chambers

8×8 · 6 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Partial spine splits the board into two rooms connected top and bottom. Two-theater duels; rook files die at the spine.

The Shelf s08-the-shelf

9×7 · 5 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Corner bite INTO the north deployment zone — the molding showcase: black cannot deploy wide-left and must squish right. Tests deployment on broken ground.

Long Nave s09-long-nave

4×10 · 2 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 7×2

Long and narrow (4x10) with staggered pillars. Deep approach marches; promotion runs matter.

Broken Crossing s10-broken-crossing

8×10 · 8 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Two broken wall arms leave three routes of different widths. Route-choice terrain at mid scale.

Grand Hall s11-grand-hall

10×10 · 5 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

The 10x10 upper bound: mostly open, three scattered pillars, a two-cell alcove on the east wall. Tests wide-board play, search cost, and phone rendering.

Rat Warren s12-rat-warren

10×8 · 13 walls · largest mirror army that fits: 8×2

Dense pockets (13 walls): parallel 1-2 wide runs and dead ends. The wall-density stress case — quake starvation, locked pawns, fall-through.
